message.abstract: <jats:p>We present a survey of combinatorial set theory relevant to the study of singular cardinals and their successors. The topics covered include diamonds, squares, club guessing, forcing axioms, and PCF theory.</jats:p>
title: Notes on Singular Cardinal Combinatorics
